purpose: Literal, hand-frozen digests for the invariant set, baseline cases, and three mutant descriptors, computed once and recorded here as plain data -- NOT recomputed into constants at import time by fixtures.ts. The conformance test suite independently re-derives these digests at run time from the live fixture code and checks them byte-for-byte against these literal values. The actual precommitment anchor is the git commit that introduces this file, pushed to origin BEFORE the verification run being reported as evidence: anyone can check out that exact commit and reproduce every value below independently, without trusting anything computed in the same process as the comparison.
digest_algorithm: sha256 hex, over a stably-key-sorted JSON serialization; see conformance/tsei-invariant-discrimination-v0/model.ts's stableStringify/canonicalDigest
